### download

<a id="expec-64356339363632382d633766352d346638632d393162322d373966666362366335303661"></a>


- Can be cancelled

### export

<a id="expec-34656135656164612d633633362d346365332d613531332d653230613539353261383566"></a>

```expec
capability export(result: ResultPayload, targetLocation: URL) returns Nothing fails with ResultRelayExportError
```

Returns: Nothing (no value)

May fail with: [ResultRelayExportError](#expec-39653035633439642d303933302d343731382d383565622d313236393431353932643939)

- The result has been sent to a provided target
- Creates a temporary backing file
- Can support large results
- Can be cancelled
- Cleanup
